business_scope.primary_industry_name: Maritime Seafarer Staffing and Vessel Crew Management Agency

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 33 of 2016 (as amended); International Companies Act No. 31 of 1992 (as amended, including the International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 20 of 2011 establishing the beneficial ownership register requirement); Companies Act [Cap. 191]; Foreign Investment Promotion Act [Cap. 243]; Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap. 149]; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 1993. The UBO and AML/CFT regime is administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU), and licensed registered agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the applicant's jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority / notary public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (bank statement or utility bill dated within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating bank or utility authority, notarized in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized bank reference letter confirming banking history and beneficial ownership
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing correspondent bank in applicant's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Charter / Memorandum and Articles of Association signed by founding shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding shareholders and directors, notarized in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or company secretary of the shareholder's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based PEP screening of all shareholders, directors, UBOs, and authorized signatories against PEP databases, OFAC SDN, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions listings, and Vanuatu domestic targeted financial sanctions lists. Screening is mandated under Part 4 customer due diligence obligations of the AML/CFT Act No. 33 of 2016 and applies to the licensed registered agent and corporate secretarial service provider. Enhanced due diligence is automatically required for PEPs, family members, and close associates. Negative screening results must be logged, documented, and retained per the statutory retention period.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company and International Company Name Reservation Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The VFSC registry operates in English; proposed corporate names must be submitted in the Latin script. Non-Latin script names must be transliterated into Latin characters. French and Bislama words are accepted, but the name must not be misleading in any of the three official languages (Bislama, English, French). The International Companies Act No. 31 of 1992 imposes mandatory corporate suffix requirements and prohibits names that are identical or confusingly similar to names already reserved or registered.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Vanuatu (where implying official sponsorship or misleading state connection)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Where a name is rejected, the applicant or licensed registered agent must lodge a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies at the VFSC within 14 days of rejection. The appeal must demonstrate distinctiveness and address the stated grounds for refusal. Where the refusal is based on a restricted token, the applicant must first obtain ministerial consent or the sector regulator's approval, such as approval from the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu for bank or trust tokens or clearance from Vanuatu Maritime Services Limited for maritime-related tokens. An adverse determination may be challenged by judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Civil Procedure Rules.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for the International Company's administrative shell and correspondence functions through a VFSC-licensed registered agent. However, the licensed Ship Crew Recruitment and Manning Agency (ISIC 5222) requires a substantive physical operating office and a locally responsible person for Vanuatu Maritime Services Limited (VMSL) licensing, Maritime Labour Convention 2006 compliance, and multi-currency crew payroll AML supervision. Therefore, a pure virtual office with no physical operational footprint is not acceptable for the licensed activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 20% to 30% estimated probability of unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months for licensed crew recruitment and manning agencies under VMSL flag-state inspection and MLC 2006 audit programs. VFSC registered-office inspections are uncommon but may occur where AML/CFT risk indicators arise.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], ss.4-12 (incorporation), ss.26-29 (registered office), ss.51-58 (directors and company secretary)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with Form 1 (Application for Incorporation); Certificate of Incorporation issued upon registration
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; shares must be issued at par value as stated in the Articles. No escrow account or capital deposit requirement applies to a standard International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company accepts the subscriber shares allotted to its incorporators as recorded in the register of members. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be established at the address provided to VFSC, with the licensed registered agent authorized to maintain such office. RESOLVED FURTHER that the individuals named as first directors and first company secretary be appointed to act until removal or resignation. RESOLVED FURTHER that the directors are authorized to open bank accounts, execute banking mandates, and file all regulatory applications and license submissions required for the maritime crew recruitment business. RESOLVED that all actions taken by the incorporators in connection with incorporation are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry – Online Filing Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 1A (Name Reservation Request) through the VFSC portal with the proposed company name, review the name availability against the national names database, and pay the prescribed reservation fee. Obtain written name approval before proceeding.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the applicant may submit an alternate name within 5 business days or lodge an administrative appeal with VFSC for reconsideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent and Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act, have the subscriber shareholders execute them in the presence of a notary, and obtain the registered agent's signed consent to act.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft and signed)
Subscriber register and share allotment schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the documents are queried for legal sufficiency, the registered agent will amend the submission and resubmit within 3 business days after client confirmation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Filing and Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed Memorandum and Articles, Form 1 (Application for Incorporation), Notice of Registered Office, and officer consent forms to VFSC. Pay the official incorporation fee. VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation after the statutory review.
required_dossiers: Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act of first directors and company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a correction query, cure by filing an amended form or supplementary declaration within 14 calendar days; failure to cure timely may result in rejection with refund of fees, but re-filing is permitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office and Registered Agent Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the registered office agreement with the licensed agent and confirm the physical address in Vanuatu to VFSC. Ensure the agent maintains the statutory registers at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office address is found invalid, appoint a new licensed agent and file a notice of change with VFSC within 7 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Identification Number and VAT Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Tax Identification Number using the Certificate of Incorporation and supporting corporate documents. Assess whether any VAT obligation arises under the Value Added Tax Act for locally chargeable services, and register accordingly if taxable supplies exceed the threshold.
required_dossiers: Name and passport copy of authorized officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected due to incomplete information, provide the requested particulars within 10 business days and file an administrative review request with the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Licence Issuance for Physical Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Finance and Economic Management – Business Licence Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Business Licence application under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 15], attaching the incorporation certificate, lease agreement, and municipal zoning clearance. Pay the annual licence fee based on the business classification.
required_dossiers: Local authority zoning or occupancy approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business Licence office queries the application, correct the noted deficiencies through the Business Licence Unit and, if the licence is still denied, appeal to the Minister of Finance within 21 days of the refusal notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Maritime Authority (VMA) – Seafarer Recruitment and Placement Licensing Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Crew Recruitment and Manning Agency Licence

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Low-impact commercial service; environmental registration only, full EIA not required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge or VOC emissions from typical office-based agency operations; sanitary wastewater must meet municipal sewer discharge standards, and solid waste must be segregated and disposed of in accordance with the Vanuatu Waste Management Guidelines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services; structural load compliance and building occupancy certificate from the Public Works Department; workplace health and safety registration under the Vanuatu Employment (Workplace Health and Safety) Act, including marine crew interview room and records storage clearance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), an integrated revenue authority under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official services portal and lodgement channels accessible via the VRC administrative website and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) company registry portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Vanuatu International Company (IC) is incorporated through a licensed registered agent at the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); the agent files the notice of incorporation, memorandum and articles, and beneficial ownership declarations. No automatic VAT or corporate income tax registration arises, as the IC is subject to the statutory tax exemption under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222). If a TIN is sought for customs duty accounts, employer obligations, or other administrative purposes, the agent submits a TIN application to VRC using the certificate of incorporation, a certified copy of the registered agent's licence, the registered office confirmation, and the passport/certified identification of the ultimate beneficial owner; VRC issues the TIN upon verification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, partnership classification, or hybrid-mismatch election is available under Vanuatu law. The International Companies Act (Cap. 222) automatically grants the IC an exemption from all Vanuatu taxes (income tax, stamp duty, capital gains, and any future turnover tax) for a renewable 20-year period; the entity's tax classification is fixed by statute and cannot be varied by shareholder or board election. No fiscal transparency regime exists, and an IC cannot elect to be treated as a corporation, partnership, or pass-through for Vanuatu tax purposes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT/GST or sales and use tax in Vanuatu; the indirect taxation framework comprises customs and excise duties, a prescribed Turnover Tax (e.g., 3.5% on hospitality and tour services), and municipal Business Licence Tax, none of which attach to an exempt International Company when properly constituted.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no VAT/GST statute and therefore no economic turnover threshold for indirect tax registration. The only potentially applicable triggers are: (i) customs registration as importer/exporter for physical goods movements, and (ii) municipal business licence registration for any actual economic operation within Port Vila or Luganville; International Companies remain exempt provided no business is conducted with Vanuatu residents and no land is held.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing, API reporting, or digital stamping mandate exists in Vanuatu; VRC operates a risk-based customs declaration processing system, and invoicing remains a private commercial matter subject to normal record-keeping rules under the corporate registry and AML frameworks.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — Vanuatu does not levy VAT/GST, so there is no export zero-rating mechanism to claim. The export of ship crew recruitment and maritime crew management services by an IC falls entirely outside Vanuatu's indirect tax net: no turnover tax, export duty, or other consumption tax is imposed on offshore service fees settled by non-resident shipping principals. Physical export of goods is generally zero-rated by absence of duty, except for scheduled commodities subject to specific export duties under the Customs Act; a crew agency does not ordinarily generate goods exports.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (only where crew stores, equipment, or mobilisation effects are shipped out of Vanuatu)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (evidencing physical movement of any accompanying goods, stores, or equipment)
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT banking credit evidence from the vessel owner/operator (to substantiate the offshore consideration received for crew supply and payroll services)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no VAT zero-rating to claw back; the material legal risks arise from (i) misrepresenting goods to VRC customs to obtain invalid duty relief on crew stores or vessels, which yields assessments, interest at the statutory rate, civil penalties under the Customs Act, and seizure/forfeiture of goods; (ii) an IC engaging in prohibited domestic business with Vanuatu residents, which voids the statutory tax exemption and retrospectively exposes the entity to income tax, municipal business licence tax, turnover tax, and penalties; and (iii) false declarations or AML breaches under VFSC supervision, which may result in registration cancellation, deregistration of the IC, financial penalties, and adverse regulatory sanction against the licensed registered agent.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 282], acting as the central bank, monetary authority, and licensing body for all commercial banks and licensed FX dealers in the Republic of Vanuatu.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberal exchange-control framework with no material capital-account restrictions. The Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible on both current and capital account. For an International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], share subscription, capital injections, loan servicing, dividend distribution, and profit repatriation to non-resident owners are permitted without prior RBV approval, quantitative quotas, or withholding levies. The IC is a tax-exempt non-resident vehicle, so no taxation or exchange-control surcharge attaches to outward remittances. The practical constraints are liquidity depth (VUV/USD/AUD/EUR), correspondent-bank de-risking appetite, and documentation formality rather than statutory convertibility limits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio on export or service receipts. Crew recruitment management fees, manning agency service revenue, and payroll-funding remittances may be retained in any convertible currency (USD, AUD, EUR, NZD, GBP) in onshore or offshore accounts. No time-bound repatriation or conversion window applies. The only obligations are AML/CFT reporting by RBV-licensed banks of foreign-currency and wire transactions above thresholds prescribed by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU), plus accurate booking of the economic substance of the transaction to satisfy beneficial-ownership transparency requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operating Account (multi-currency USD/AUD/VUV) with dedicated Capital Escrow Sub-Account for paid-in surplus and crew-payroll clearing
Operational VUV/USD Account and Statutory Surety Deposit Account for maritime agency licensing bonds
Operational Account with EUR/USD/AUD capabilities and trade-finance ancillary lines for commercial LC settlement

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium for universal offshore digital EMIs. Tier-one overseas platforms (Wise, Airwallex, Currenxie, Revolut Business) generally apply blanket territorial restrictions to Vanuatu tax-exempt entities, demand local substance, an RBV-licensed domestic bank relationship, or reject VU offshore entities outright under internal jurisdiction policy; a foreign EMI is not RBV-licensed to provide payment services into Vanuatu, which limits deposit-taking and dispute-recourse protections. A niche maritime payroll EMI specialising in seafarer disbursements is viable as a supplementary clearing rail but cannot serve as the sole treasury backbone. Recommended architecture: BSP/NBV domestic account as primary liquidity anchor with a specialised shipping-payroll EMI as a settlement accelerator.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no strict statutory mandate requiring directors to appear physically in Port Vila. Vanuatu tier-1 banks generally permit fully remote account opening for an International Company when onboarding is sponsored by an in-country licensed Registered Agent, supplemented by videoconference KYC interviews with at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner. Standard requirements include: (i) VFSC-certified Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum & Articles of Association; (ii) Registered Agent attestation and beneficial-ownership declaration; (iii) passport-grade identity verification with notarisation or apostille; and (iv) a live or in-branch interview. BSP and NBV in practice prefer at least one signatory to meet an account relationship officer in Port Vila, which reduces second-stage compliance review time from weeks to days; fully remote signing is nevertheless accepted where the Registered Agent certifies signatory identity and authority.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque or non-disclosed beneficial-ownership chain typical of a Vanuatu International Company, triggering automated negative-news and ownership-layering flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing; register of members and current beneficial-ownership register filed under Vanuatu transparency rules; Registered Agent letter confirming UBO identification; sworn ownership declaration covering every natural person in the chain; passport copies of all directors and UBOs; corporate resolution authorising account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction-level reputational flag referencing Vanuatu's historical FATF-context grey-list profile and correspondent-bank de-risking sensitivity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current-year Certificate of Good Standing from VFSC; Registered Agent AML/CFT compliance policy and licensing evidence; bank-certified source-of-funds trail for the opening deposit; detailed maritime crewmanning business plan evidencing real economic activity; statutory seafarer recruitment/crew agency licence showing regulated sector status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency multi-country payroll wires to seafarer beneficiaries in disparate jurisdictions inconsistent with declared crew-management operations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master crew list cross-referenced to flagged and managed vessels; IMO/flag-state vessel registration extracts; seafarer employment contracts compliant with STCW/MLC 2006 standards; payroll run sheet with wage scales and manning projections; shipowner or charterer crewing services agreement; and corresponding manning invoices justifying each beneficiary jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP, sanctions-list, or adverse-media match on a director, UBO, or authorised signatory during initial screening or ongoing transaction monitoring
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions and PEP screening report from a recognised due-diligence provider; sworn explanation with explanatory memorandum; corroborating government-issued identity documentation; professional reference from a reputable maritime or banking counterpart; adverse-media research file demonstrating disposition or irrelevance; confirmation of no active sanctions designation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital for the IC is routed via SWIFT MT103 for standard equity injections and MT202/COVER for large bank-to-bank transfers, denominated in USD or AUD and credited to the Capital Escrow Sub-Account under the bank relationship. The wire payment reference must clearly state 'Capital Contribution / Paid-in Surplus — [Company Name]' and be supported by a sole-member or board resolution authorising the capital injection and specifying the account of credit. Vanuatu does not operate a mandatory SAFE-style purpose-code regime, but the narrative field and underlying documentation must align with the crewmanning business model and identify the remitter's source of funds to avoid an AML compliance hold. The receiving bank will require: (i) registry extract or share-certificate evidence; (ii) corporate resolution; (iii) remitter bank source-of-funds confirmation; and (iv) UBO declaration of the contributing member.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury flows clear through: (1) SWIFT MT103 priority payments for seafarer wage settlements in the crew member's designated currency (USD, EUR, PHP, IDR, INR, and other major currencies) via the bank's FX dealing desk; (2) multi-currency host-to-host payroll files initiated through BSP or NBV direct channels for vessels under pooled crew management; (3) commercial Letters of Credit, both sight and usance, issued or confirmed for shipowner/charterer reimbursement and master-hire obligations; and (4) interbank domestic VUV/USD instant transfers for Port Vila operational expenditures and local statutory licence fee payments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable forward FX contracts (USD/AUD/EUR versus VUV) with tenors up to 12 months executed through RBV-licensed commercial banks, subject to the bank's credit line and underlying crew-payroll exposure

Cross-currency swaps (fixed-to-fixed and floating-to-fixed) transacted bilaterally with the relationship bank for rebalancing multi-currency payroll funding and matching USD receivables against EUR/PHP disbursement liabilities
FX swaps (spot versus forward) used for settlement-date liquidity bridging between VUV, USD, and AUD

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in VUV are not permissible due to the absence of a liquid NDF market for the Vatu; any non-VUV NDF (e.g., AUD/USD) may be used solely to hedge third-currency payroll exposure and must be documented under the corporate treasury policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Licence Renewal (International Company, ISIC 5222 crew agency)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the anniversary of incorporation; annual renewal fee payable before 31 December of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of VUV 10,000 (~USD 85) per month, compounded up to 12 months; failure to file and pay for 3 consecutive months triggers administrative strike-off under the International Companies Act (Cap 222).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation and Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Beneficial Ownership Registry (filed via registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the Annual Return, and within 28 days of any change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing is an offence under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2016; penalties up to VUV 1,000,000 (~USD 8,300), with repeat offenders subject to director disqualification and eventual strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Maritime Crew Recruitment Agency Licence Annual Renewal (sector-specific statutory licence)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Maritime Safety Authority (VMSA) / Commissioner of Maritime Affairs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the anniversary date of licence issuance, annually; application must be submitted at least 30 days prior to expiry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Renewal after expiry incurs a late fee of 20% of the annual fee; operation without renewed licence results in licence suspension, administrative fine, and prohibition on recruiting or deploying seafarers.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for a tax-exempt International Company under the International Companies Act, unless the VFSC specifically directs an audit, or shareholders representing at least 25% of voting rights request one; a maritime crew recruitment agency must instead produce an annual internal solvency and staffing compliance statement for the VMSA.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; simplified local GAAP acceptable for small exempt operations with no public accountability.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must submit an annual UBO confirmation to VFSC through its registered agent, listing all individuals with 25% or more shares, voting control, or senior management influence; any share transfer or ownership change must be recorded in the UBO ledger and reported via the annual return. Failure to update for transfers triggers the penalties stated in the matrix.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book and Share Transfer Records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – USD 4,500 (if voluntarily commissioned or required by VFSC/VMSA)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no payroll tax, no capital gains tax, and no value-added tax. International Companies (ICs) are wholly exempt from any national income tax. The only applicable charges are the annual government registration fee and the licensed agent fee, plus minor compliance levies under the International Companies Act. No statutory tax incentives are required as the effective rate is already zero.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form ICAR) submitted to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through a licensed registered agent via the VFSC Online Services Portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary date of incorporation. The return is prepared as at that anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name and unique IC registration number as recorded by the VFSC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the exact name as shown in the Certificate of Incorporation. Ensure no abbreviation unless official.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 — Registered Office Address in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office maintained by the licensed agent in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a real street address in Vanuatu; a P.O. Box alone is insufficient. Confirm with local agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 — Registered Agent Name and Address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full details of the licensed registered agent in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Automatically populated; verify annual agent renewal before submission.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, nationalities, addresses, and shareholdings of all shareholders and directors as of the anniversary date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors may be listed without any local residency requirement. Provide passport copies and proof of address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: A concise statement of the company’s principal business activity, referencing ISIC 5222 maritime seafarer staffing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Clearly state 'Ship crew recruitment and crew management agency'. Do not state activities that would require a domestic local trading license.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that financial records are kept and available, or a statutory declaration of solvency where applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: ICSs are not required to file audited financial statements with the VFSC, but the directors must maintain adequate records offshore or in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of a director or the registered agent on behalf of the board, with date of signing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Electronic signature accepted when filed via portal. Non-resident directors can sign digitally by proxy to the agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a penalty of VT 5,000. Continued default after a month triggers an additional penalty of VT 1,000 per day up to VT 20,000. Persistent non-filing can result in the Registrar striking the company off the register, asset freeze, and forfeiture of assets to the Vanuatu government.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No domestic withholding tax is imposed on dividends paid by a Vanuatu International Company. Vanuatu does not maintain a comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network; only tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) exist with certain OECD states. There is no administrative process for claiming treaty relief on outbound dividends because no withholding arises. A non-resident shareholder receiving distributions does not need to obtain a tax residency certificate from Vanuatu; the tax treatment is governed exclusively by the shareholder’s residence jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% for interest, royalties, and technical service fees paid by an IC to non-residents. No Vanuatu source-based taxation. Where a counterparty insists on treaty certainty, Vanuatu's TIEAs do not provide direct tax relief but do facilitate exchange of financial information among tax authorities.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing regime exists in Vanuatu. There is no Local File or Master File requirement and no comparable threshold in local currency (Vatu). The country does not impose income tax, so the arm’s length principle is not codified in domestic law, but a prudent IC should document intra-group charges for crew payroll, management fees, and procurement as a safeguard against any substance or AML challenges.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu’s International Companies (Economic Substance) Act, No. 28 of 2019 requires an IC engaged in a 'relevant activity' to demonstrate adequate economic substance in Vanuatu. A ship crew recruitment agency is categorically related to 'shipping' or a 'distribution and service centre' depending on the precise revenue model. The IC must maintain a physical office or arrangement for board meetings in Vanuatu, have locally based staff where applicable, and incur proportionate local operating expenditure. A strict 'one-man shell' with no supporting substance is considered non-compliant and may trigger a penalty and forced strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Return / Striking Off
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to submit the International Company Annual Return to the VFSC within 30 days after the incorporation anniversary.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late filing penalty up to VT 20,000; subsequent default leads to administrative strike-off under Section 123 of the International Companies Act. The company’s assets are dissolved and may be claimed by the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally liable for all debts of the company if the company trades after being struck off. The Court may grant restoration only upon payment of penalties and a bond, potentially exposing directors to personal costs.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Carrying on Domestic Business without a Local Trade License
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An IC engages in ordinary Vanuatu-internal business — including recruiting crew for a domestic domestic vessel operator or earning income from Vanuatu-sourced services — without applying for a local trade licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC is prohibited from carrying on business in Vanuatu. Violations may result in a fine up to VT 500,000 and confiscation of profits earned from the unauthorized activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly cause the company to conduct unlicensed domestic business may be convicted of an offence, leading to a personal fine of up to VT 200,000 and imprisonment for up to two years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a crew payroll remittance service without registered AML policies, or processing payments that involve known sanction parties, forged vessel documents, or fragmented cash deposits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2002 (as amended), an IC can be fined up to VT 100 million. The VFSC can revoke the certificate of incorporation and refer to the Financial Intelligence Unit for criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face imprisonment up to 15 years and/or fine up to VT 50 million. Travel bans may be imposed pending investigation. The court can freeze personal assets and order disgorgement of any illicit gains.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Providing Crewing Services Without a VFSC or Maritime License
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a ship crew recruitment and management agency in or from Vanuatu without holding the relevant Vanuatu Maritime Services (VMS) maritime labour supplier licence or the required VFSC activity permit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: An unlicensed recruitment operation is a criminal offence under the Maritime Workers Act and the VMS circulars; fines reach VT 1 million per vessel crew placed, and the company is barred from all maritime business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director is personally criminally liable for every crew placement made without a licence, with penalties of imprisonment for up to 5 years and a personal fine not exceeding VT 2 million. In addition, all fees collected may be recoverable as a civil debt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting a statutory declaration of economic substance to claim tax exemption while not maintaining a real office, staff, or board governance in Vanuatu — i.e., a pure mailbox arrangement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to VT 5 million and mandatory strike-off. Any jurisdictional benefits, including the IC’s zero-tax status, are retroactively revoked, and the IC is liable for any unpaid domestic taxes on income attributable to Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors signing a false declaration may be convicted of perjury and fraud, incurring personal fines up to VT 3 million and imprisonment up to 7 years. They are also jointly and severally liable for the company’s tax liabilities if the veil is pierced.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion in the Shareholder’s Home Jurisdiction
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a Vanuatu IC to accumulate ship crew fees and dividends while failing to report the income to the ultimate beneficial owner’s tax authority, or structuring contracts solely to avoid CRS reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu does not impose a sanction itself but will exchange data under TIEAs and the Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters. The shareholder’s home country has full jurisdiction to assess penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director/shareholder is exposed to home-country criminal tax evasion charges. Vanuatu courts have recognized foreign judgments for tax collection under the Reciprocal Enforcement of Judgments Act; personal assets in Vanuatu can be attached, and a foreign arrest warrant can be executed in Vanuatu for extraditable tax offences.
